records.prompt: Create ONE website-ready landscape 1536x1024 image, exactly 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, six 512x512 cells, no gutters, borders or panel labels. Use the referenced actual original photograph as identity source; edit the actual product, never substitute stock. Reading-order cells: 1 entire original assortment on clean white; 2 same entire assortment on lavender/cream styled surface; 3 same entire assortment in a tasteful vanity lifestyle scene; 4 standalone tight macro of a real visible pendant and chain, only this part not whole assortment; 5 same entire assortment promotional photo with heading BLACK CIRCLE PENDANT NECKLACES; 6 plain blank cream unused. Full product entirely inside each cell with generous margins and no cross-cell overlap. Preserve EXACTLY THREE original necklaces on THREE long white cards within clear packaging, overlapping diagonal arrangement, fine gold-tone chains and one original pendant on each card. Remove hand, shop background and large external price/material/lifetime-warranty overlay. Retain actual packaging identity without adding claims. No extra necklaces, extra pendants, gemstones, colour or shape changes. Website quality sufficient. The pendants are circular black centres inside narrow gold-tone rings with tiny ring lettering, one black round pendant per chain/card, THREE total. Preserve circular silhouette, black centres and gold ring/chain colour. Macro cell shows actual black circle and gold ring.
records.visual_review: Source grid preserved; individual crop records carry website-view reviews.
